notes.title: Silly comedy adventure Edgar - Bokbok in Boulzac gets a permanent price drop
notes.notes:
Edgar - Bokbok in Boulzac, a comedy point and click adventure by La Poule Noire that released in early 2020 has been given a big permanent price cut.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/01/silly-comedy-adventure-edgar-bokbok-in-boulzac-gets-a-permanent-price-drop

notes.title: EDGAR - BOKBOK IN BOULZAC cut it price by two, forever!
notes.notes:
Dear all,

We have decided to halve the price and allow more people to participate in the adventures of Edgar and Precious. 

Bok bok to all of you !

notes.title: Take your chicken on a wild adventure in 'Edgar - Bokbok in Boulzac' - out now
notes.notes: Take control of the outcast Edgar, a rather quirky individual who wears a tin hat and talks to their Chicken in 'Edgar - Bokbok in Boulzac' and it's out now.

notes.title: Steam demo version available
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34333787/6670edbbd7afc3546d2cc86f236782a82bc69c43.png[/img]

Hello there,


All the team from La Poule Noire is proud to share with you the demo version of Edgar Bokbok in Boulzac. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vU1C3lm.gif[/img]

You can download it on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1007830/Edgar__Bokbok_in_Boulzac/]Steam page.[/url]

It’s time for your first trip into the city of Boulzac, with tons of colorful characters, a hen, squashes to save and a mysterious conspiracy! 



Edgar is a comic narrative game set in a weird and rich universe. The action takes place in a small village, reminiscent of the french countryside with its share of cliché and fascinating characters.


[h1]Teaser:[/h1]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qMAg5l_Ifbs


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34333787/d48122b60f5efc4a20479f3b1b3339f6370d7543.png[/img]

And if you want more, you can register to our [url=https://twitter.us18.list-manage.com/subscribe?u=19123fca6a5ba57a13dadf2d2&id=51173ebd1e]newsletter[/url] to know when we launch (we don’t spam)

And that’s all for today, we’ll be back soon!!!
Bok bok to you!!!
